items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the ph-topology version of the proper push-pull identity, deduced from the etale case (statement lines 22289-22293). The proof (proof lines 22295-22319) reduces by reflection of isomorphisms through epsilon_{Y,*} and the description of the pullbacks, then identifies the composite with part (1) of the comparison lemma for proper morphisms. H2: one reduction and one identification.
